description: Create a reusable payment link (POST /payment-links), paid into your own account in the currency's country. Test key = test link; live key = a real link to share.

amount.description: Fixed price, or null to let the payer choose.

currency.description: Currency of the link: GHS, KES, UGX, NGN or USD.

description.description: More detail shown to the payer (optional).

ships_goods.description: true when goods are delivered after payment.

title.description: Name of the link, shown to the payer.

name: create_payment_link
title: Create a payment link
